title: Course: CS 263 | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Course: CS 263 | EECS at UC Berkeley CS 263. Design of Programming Languages Catalog Description: Selected topics from: analysis, comparison, and design of programming languages, formal description of syntax and semantics, advanced programming techniques, structured programming, debugging, verification of programs and compilers, and proofs of correctness. Units: 3 Related Areas: Programming Systems (PS) Prerequisites: COMPSCI 164 Formats: Fall: 3.0 hours of lecture and 1.0 hours of discussion per week Spring: 3.0 hours of lecture and 1.0 hours of discussion per week Grading Basis: letter Final Exam Status: No final exam Class Schedule (Spring 2026): CS 263 – TuTh 14:00-15:29, Soda 310 – Max Willsey Links: EECS Course Archives (CalNet authentication required) CS enrollment policies EE enrollment policies HKN course maps
